result.reason: The added subsection reaches at least the fallback: it provides a professional-and-workmanlike Services warranty, 90-day material conformance warranty for the Site, repair/replacement/re-performance/refund remedies, legal compliance, and no malicious code. The changes are confined to the required warranty protections and preserve the existing provisions. Drafting is professional, though the conformance period would be clearer and more protective if measured from delivery or acceptance rather than the Effective Date, and the margin comment inaccurately suggests the 90-day fallback is not already in the operative text.
